verdict.rationale: Make's own help docs describe error handlers and how to use them in scenarios, which covers the dedicated error-handling-path half of the story, though only through thin index-level snippets. Nothing in the pack shows notifications (email, alert, or otherwise) when a scenario run fails. Missing for 10: any evidence of failure notifications, detail on error-handler types and path configuration, error-workflow routing, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can define dedicated error-handling paths or error workflows and get notified when a run fails
